# P29.2 — Detector/task engine + records-request loop on real data (ACTIVATE.2, Round 7)

## Summary
Turns on SIG's **self-feeding accountability loop**: the built §33.2 detector catalog (34 task types) +
records-request generation are run over the **Round-6 materialized graph** (contradictions §31, honest
coverage §32, the sharing/relationship network §29.3) to auto-produce the **research queue** ("what SIG
is looking at next") and **statute-templated records requests** — the next round of evidence to gather.
The whole §33 engine, `records_request.py`, `geographic.py`, the anti-abuse, and the Round-6 read seams
are **CONSUMED, not re-implemented** (SIG-ENG-035); the new code is pure orchestration + the DB write
path that persistence had been deferred on (ADR-039).

Implements `docs/tickets/P29.2__detector-records-request-loop.md` (§33 detector DSL / lifecycle /
dispositions / geo queues / anti-abuse; §33.4 records-request generation; §32 coverage).

## Gate — DRAFT, NEVER SEND (operator decision recorded)
The ticket's gate is the **operator gate to actually SEND records requests** (an external side effect).
The operator has **NOT** authorized sending. So records requests are **drafted, not sent** — no consenting
filer is fabricated, no transmit path exists or is added, and `records_requests_sent` is always `0`. The
actual SEND is an operator-gated deferral, `D-R7.2-SEND` (kind P, BL-057), with the exact procedure. A
drafted-not-sent request + a deferred send is the correct output.

## Design decisions
- The materialized detector output **is** the detection (P28.x already ran §31/§32/§29 over the spine), so
  the detector run **routes** each materialized row to its catalog resolution task rather than fabricating
  detector-firing facts — honest, and exactly the SIG-TASK-004 contract. No new ADR (semantics consumed).
- Records requests draft the ready-to-file **materials** (statute + template) with the **filer left for the
  contributor who files it** — SIG fabricates no consent (SIG-TASK-018) and there is no send path.
- The trigger is stored durably on the row (queryable) and surfaced on the public queue.
